heading: Tuesday, July 22, 2025
topLine: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Coder agentic coding model.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Coder agentic coding model
items.summary: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct is an open-weight MoE coding model (480B total, 35B active) with 256K native context, released with the open-source Qwen Code CLI. Qwen claims state-of-the-art results among open models on agentic coding and SWE-Bench Verified, comparable to Claude Sonnet 4.
